reason: This is not just a narrow test-only or one-off bug fix: it touches shared executor spill/fallback paths for `TopN`, `Sort`, and `Aggregate`, plus the common memory action logic in `pkg/util/memory/action.go`. That puts it in executor runtime-correctness territory with cross-operator blast radius under memory pressure. Bugs here are unlikely to be purely cosmetic; they can cause wrong fallback behavior, unexpected query failure, or OOM/regression in production. Even though the surface area is small, the changed paths are central enough and shared enough to justify a focused deep review for High issues.
